criterion: RT workstream stage R2: our own BVH built by compute, a compute path tracer with a stable interface and AOVs, and hybrid ray-traced shadows and reflections over the R1 visibility buffer
written: 2026-10-10, before the implementation and the first run

method.bvh: PLOC (Meister and Bittner, 'Parallel Locally-Ordered Clustering for Bounding Volume Hierarchy Construction', IEEE TVCG 2018), from the paper: 30-bit Morton codes of triangle centroids in the scene box, a bitonic sort of (code, index), then rounds of nearest-neighbour search within radius 16 by the surface area of the merged box (ties to the lower index), merging of mutual neighbours, and compaction by prefix sums. No atomics: node ids and positions come from scans. A CPU reference runs the same algorithm in the same float32 operation order. Leaves hold one triangle.
method.traversal: closest hit and any hit with a stack, the ray-triangle test of raw/math/primitives.hpp (Moeller-Trumbore) written in the same operation order
method.sah_cost: C_trav = 1, C_isect = 1: sum over internal nodes of A(n) / A(root) plus sum over leaves of A(l) / A(root) times its triangle count
method.path_tracer: unidirectional, next-event estimation for a sun and emissive triangles, multiple importance sampling between BSDF sampling and emitter sampling, Russian roulette after bounce 3 with the survival probability recorded; materials: Lambert plus a GGX metal-roughness lobe (Walter et al. 2007; VNDF sampling, Heitz 2018), our own implementation, base colour from the R1 procedural textures; the counter-based hash RNG PCG2D seeded from (seed, pixel, sample, bounce)
method.interface: raw/renderer/rt_pathtrace.hpp, version 1: PathTraceDesc {seed, spp, maxBounces, width, height, camera, previous camera}; outputs per pixel: radiance (RGB, linear, unclamped), albedo (first-hit base colour), normal (first-hit shading normal, world), depth (first-hit view distance, 0 for a miss), motion (screen-space pixel offset to the previous camera, for static scenes), variance (per-pixel sample variance of radiance luminance, divided by spp); the same seed, spp and scene give the same bytes on one backend

B1_build_identity.what: the GPU PLOC build against the CPU PLOC reference on the owned scenes (retro_room, iso_street, clip_stress), a procedural 100,000-triangle city block (dense_block, owned) and a seeded 20,000-triangle soup
B1_build_identity.bound: the same tree: node for node, the same children, the same leaf triangles and bit-identical boxes
B1_build_identity.control: the GPU build with radius 8 instead of 16 must give a different tree on dense_block

B2_traversal.what: 100,000 seeded rays per scene (half random, half camera rays), closest hit and any hit
B2_traversal.bound: the CPU traversal of the GPU-built tree returns exactly the brute-force scan's answer (same triangle, same t, ties to the lower index); the GPU traversal returns the same triangle except where the brute-force scan's two nearest hits lie within 1e-5 relative t (counted), with |t difference| <= 1e-5 t; any-hit answers equal
B2_traversal.control: the GPU traversal with the box test's far limit shortened by 10% must miss hits

B3_sah.what: SAH cost of the GPU-built tree against the M3 binned-SAH BVH (raw/renderer/bvh.hpp, leaves of up to 4 triangles), same scenes
B3_sah.reported: build time on WARP and on the RTX 4090 (under the GPU lock), not bounded

P1_furnace.what: a closed box with emission E on every face and Lambert albedo a = 0.5 and 0.8 on every face, GPU path tracer at 64 spp, no Russian roulette cut-off beyond 64 bounces
P1_furnace.bound: image mean within 4 standard errors of E / (1 - a); every pixel within 6 of its own standard errors
P1_furnace.control: the tracer with the cosine factor dropped from the Lambert estimator must fail

P2_convergence.what: the GPU path tracer against the CPU path tracer on retro_room (sun plus an emissive ceiling panel) and iso_street at 128 x 96, each at 256 spp with different seeds
P2_convergence.bound: per-pixel z = (gpu - cpu) / sqrt(var_gpu / n + var_cpu / n) on luminance: mean |z| <= 0.9 (0.80 expected for normal noise), fraction |z| > 4 <= 0.2%; image mean luminance within 3 combined standard errors
P2_convergence.control: the GPU tracer with next-event estimation's MIS weight forced to 1 (double counting) must fail

P3_determinism.what: the GPU path tracer run twice with the same seed and spp; and once with seed + 1
P3_determinism.bound: the same seed gives bit-identical radiance and AOVs; seed + 1 changes at least 99% of radiance pixels on retro_room

P4_aovs.what: albedo, normal, depth and triangle of the first hit against the R1 rasterizer's visibility buffer for the same camera, pixel centres, no jitter
P4_aovs.bound: triangle equal except within 1 px of an edge (counted); depth relative difference <= 1e-4; normal dot >= 1 - 1e-5; albedo equal (same texel) except at texel boundaries (counted)

H1_shadows.what: ray-traced sun shadows from the R1 visibility buffer (position from the perspective-correct interpolation), on the GPU, against CPU any-hit rays from the same positions
H1_shadows.bound: at most 0.1% of covered pixels differ, every difference within 1e-3 of grazing (|n . l| < 1e-3) or with an occluder hit within 1e-4 relative distance of the light-side limit (counted)
H1_shadows.control: shadow rays from the position without the offset along the normal must show self-shadowing (acne) above the bound

H2_reflections.what: one mirror bounce from every visibility-buffer pixel on retro_room and iso_street, GPU closest hit against the CPU brute-force scan
H2_reflections.bound: the same reflected triangle on at least 99.9% of pixels; every other within 1 px of a primary edge or at a t tie (1e-5 relative), counted
H2_reflections.control: reflection about the face normal negated must fail

scenes: owned and procedural: R1's retro_room, iso_street and clip_stress; dense_block (a 100,000-triangle city block of boxes, stairs and cylinders, generated in code); a seeded triangle soup; the furnace box
backends: D3D12 WARP and WebGPU SwiftShader gate; the RTX 4090 only under D:/gpu.lock.d, reported separately
does_not_prove: That the path tracer agrees with the M3 material model (it implements Lambert plus GGX only; the M3 model is a later interface version); performance against hardware ray tracing; denoising quality; any claim about scenes not run.

addendum_1.written: 2026-10-10 18:27Z, after the BVH runs (B1 to B3) and before any path-tracer code or run
addendum_1.aov_definitions: depth is the first hit's distance along the camera's forward axis (positive; 0 for a miss) and motion the pixel offset of that hit under the previous camera, both from the unjittered ray through the pixel centre; albedo and normal are means over every primary sample (the convention of learned denoisers); radiance is the mean of all samples; variance is the sample variance of radiance luminance divided by spp
addendum_1.materials: Lambert weight albedo (1 - metallic) / pi; GGX with F0 = mix(0.04 specular, albedo, metallic), Schlick Fresnel, height-correlated Smith G2; lobe choice probability metallic + (1 - metallic) 0.5 specular; the furnace uses specular 0 and metallic 0 (pure Lambert)

P0_bsdf_consistency.what: CPU: for 400 seeded (material, outgoing direction) cases over roughness 0.05 to 1, metallic 0 to 1, the directional albedo by the tracer's own importance sampling (65,536 samples) against cosine-weighted hemisphere sampling (262,144 samples) of the same BSDF evaluation
P0_bsdf_consistency.bound: |difference| <= 4 combined standard errors + 1e-3 on every case
P0_bsdf_consistency.control: the importance-sampled estimate with the VNDF pdf replaced by the plain NDF pdf (D cos theta_h / (4 |wo . h|) without G1) must fail on at least one case
